articles.title: US Senate to vote on advancing CLARITY Act in September after Thune files cloture
articles.snippet: The procedural move puts crypto market structure legislation back on track as lawmakers continue negotiations over ethics and stablecoin provisions.

articles.title: Senate Keeps Clarity Act Alive With Crypto Bill Vote Set for September
articles.snippet: Senate Majority Leader John Thune filed the motion to proceed early Saturday, setting up a mid-September showdown.

articles.title: Bitcoin AI Security Audit Files 4,962 Findings Across 390 Projects
articles.snippet: A volunteer group is pointing AI agents at Bitcoin project codebases and says 720 of the issues it has filed are high severity or critical.
